source: Produced by running the Plot Essential and Instructions Maker's own lintTransplant (index.js v0.14.2), which mirrors Summaryception's importer. CozyMaker's copy must answer every case the same.

cases.name: a sound transplant
cases.text:
<!-- SC-TRANSPLANT {"v":1,"story":"Harbour"} -->
<!-- SC-NOTEPAD -->
Keep the rain in every harbour scene.
<!-- /SC-NOTEPAD -->
<!-- SC-LEDGER {"name":"Claire"} -->
CORE: sixteen, quiet
STATE: at the harbour wall
<!-- /SC-LEDGER -->
<!-- SC-LEDGER {"name":"Aldric"} -->
CORE: general of the Iron Legion
ARC: doubts the king
<!-- /SC-LEDGER -->
<!-- SC-SNIPPET -->
They met at the pier in the rain.
<!-- SC-DETAIL -->
Her coat was too thin.
<!-- /SC-SNIPPET -->
<!-- SC-PIN -->
The promise at the lighthouse.
<!-- /SC-PIN -->
